summary: Reviewing standing access opens instantly and no longer slows the Manager for everyone else.

fixes.title: Standing access opens instantly
fixes.text: Review standing access, Revoke and the expiring-access tile now use a snapshot taken every 2 hours, and show its time. Before, each opening took minutes.

fixes.title: Refresh and revoke update the snapshot
fixes.text: Refresh queues a new read, and a revoke queues one automatically. A revoked row shows revoke queued until it is gone.
